notes.title: Keybinding is Here! Demo Version 0.5 is Live!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This update brings highly requested features and a number of improvements based on your feedback.[/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]Keybinding for keyboard controls has been implemented.[/b] You can now customize your key layout to your liking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overall image quality has been improved[/b] when using the FSR upscaling option.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Dragon Dodge[/b] key has been reassigned to [b]ALT[/b] on the keyboard and the [b]X button[/b] on controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]The parry animation has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bugs and issues have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]We appreciate all your feedback and support. Please continue to share your thoughts with us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Version! Melee Combat Improved, New Ship Furnishings, and Many Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Demo Version 0.42 Now Live![/b][/p][p]We've just released a hotfix with some important improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Melee combat AI behaviors improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Melee combat animations improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Melee combat block system improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some bugs that occurred at the beginning of the Dragon fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where birds couldn't be caught in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of birds to be hunted in the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]The Captain's Cabin in the Ship Hub has been revamped![/p][/*][*][p]Melee combat roll is now more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Animation smoothing improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Dragon tackle fixes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.3 is live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png[/img][list]
[*] Drair ground movement and melee combat animations are now smoother.
[*] Fixed Drair target lock issues.
[*] Improved Drair block system.
[*] Improved Drair Aerball throwing animation.
[*] Slightly increased dragon acceleration.
[*] Fixed bandit spawn bugs in camps.
[*] Improved Bandit NPC movements.
[*] Added new animations to Captain Terra's dialogues.
[*] Increased healing potion drop rate from enemies in camps.
[*] Optimization improvements have been made.
[*] Fixed bugs causing crashes.
[*] Ancient Stones (Tutorial) map has been slightly improved.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.22 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added lip-sync animations for NPCs!
[*] Made it easier for the dragon to land anywhere when below a certain speed.
[*] The dragon's rebound from collisions is now determined by its current speed.
[*] Added a training dummy to the Ship Hub. Feel free to beat it up!
[*] Fixed bugs during the dragon's tackle sequences.
[*] Fixed a weapon switch bug that occurred when using a controller.
[*] You can now easily holster your weapon by pressing E / (Y).
[*] Adjusted dragon checkpoint locations.
[*] Integrated FSR 3.1 Upscaling technology.
[*] Fixed various other bugs and crashes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.2 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

We've just released a hotfix to address some of the issues you've reported. Thank you for your valuable feedback!

Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when blowing things up with the dragon in camps.
[*] Resolved several bugs that were affecting the quest flow.
[*] Fixed bugs within the Blacksmith's trade menu.
[*] Improved keyboard control prompts in the tutorial.
[*] The tackle sequence in the tutorial has been made easier.
[*] Increased the number of edible birds in the tutorial.
[*] Remapped the Dragon Dodge key to 'V' for keyboard controls.
[*] Fixed an issue where the dragon would appear overly low-poly on certain graphics settings.
[*] Made general performance improvements.
[/list]

We will continue to monitor your feedback and work on further improvements. Thank you for playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png[/img]
